note: v2 adds two live disruption-risk features — weatherRisk (moderate) and advisoryRisk (heavy, overridable) — fed by server/risk/ (weather + NOTAM + GDELT news), off by default (ZKD_LIVE_RISK=1). v1 priors are the server/preferences/presets.ts weights ported onto the signed feature set and scaled by a logit temperature, so day-one ranking reproduces the previous weighted-sum behaviour. Nothing here was fitted on member data yet — `learnedByStrategy` is empty and every weight is still the prior. This is the file the offline trainer (train.ts) rewrites; the app never writes it at request time.

featureDoc.arrival: -hoursLate / scale. Higher = earlier. Monotone: earlier is never worse.
featureDoc.cost: -(fare - cheapestFare)/cheapestFare, floored at -1. Higher = cheaper. Monotone.
featureDoc.cabin: -(preferredCabinRank - altCabinRank clamped >=0). Higher = less downgrade. Monotone. [MyCa: preferred cabin]
featureDoc.loyalty: 1 if on a carrier the member holds status with, else 0. Monotone. [MyCa: preferredCarriers]
featureDoc.redeye: -1 if this is a red-eye AND the member asked to avoid them, else 0. Monotone. [MyCa: avoidRedEye]
featureDoc.seats: min(seatsSpare, 8)/8 where seatsSpare = seats - partySize. Higher = more headroom for the party. Monotone.
featureDoc.stability: -pCancel / scale, where pCancel is the trained cancellation model's own historical rate for THIS alternate's carrier+route (server/pipeline/ranker/cancelRisk.ts). Higher = the alternate is itself less likely to be cancelled. Monotone: a more-stable option is never ranked worse. [ML: cancellation model]
featureDoc.weatherRisk: -max live weather severity over the airports this candidate touches (origin, destination, hub) / scale. From server/risk/weatherRisk.ts (METAR/SIGMET). Higher = clearer skies. Monotone. [LIVE feed]
featureDoc.advisoryRisk: -max live advisory severity (NOTAM closures + GDELT news) over the candidate's airports and carrier / scale. Zeroed when overrideSevereRisk is set (the member's LLM-parsed 'no matter what'). Heavy prior. Higher = fewer active advisories. Monotone. [LIVE feed]

mycaOffsets.note: Per-member warm start. Added to the strategy prior at load time, then clipped >= 0. This is the smart initialisation: a member starts already personalised to their MyCa profile, so the learned delta only has to be small, which is what keeps the fit data-cheap and hard to overfit.

bookability.note: Enters the utility as a fixed-coefficient offset (v += log P). It is NOT a learnable weight, so no amount of data can teach the model to prefer an option it cannot book — this is what makes the old RELIABILITY_FLOOR unnecessary rather than merely enforced. Priors below are the starting P(bookable); learnedBySupplier overrides them as revalidateOffer outcomes accumulate.

shrink.note: Empirical-Bayes shrinkage, the same shape zkd-risk-model/train.py uses for entity rates: w = (n*learned + k*prior)/(n+k). Below minData the learned vector is ignored entirely and the prior is used as-is. Both are anti-overfit controls: minData is a hard gate, pseudoCount is a soft one.

explore.note: Deliberately OFF by default (epsilon 0). When enabled, swaps only ADJACENT ranks whose utility gap is below nearTieDelta — options the model already considers interchangeable — and records the propensity so offline evaluation stays unbiased. There is no exploration among options the model can actually tell apart, because a wrong flight has real cost. Learning does not depend on this being on: members overriding the top rank is natural, un-engineered exploration.
